standard: B requires the record to impose physical/column-level suppression. A requires the record to scope PHYSICAL to the witness layer and SELECTED to the invocation/output scope. The record is weighed for both, independently of present implementation convenience.

evidence_for_A.finding: The FIRST authoritative use of PHYSICAL is a workload TIER pair: bounded_physical_edge_witnesses versus full_route_empirical_anchors (33dba5236).
evidence_for_A.why_it_matters: The term was born as an evidence/access classification. It was never an I/O granularity.

evidence_for_A.finding: The C4 commission PHASE 6 — the very instrument that introduced expected_selected_reads — enumerates selected-column reads, full reads and byte counts where measurable as three SIBLING accounts (8ff40d37de69db2d8a6053a7c2242f481677f1a4).
evidence_for_A.why_it_matters: If a selected read were defined by byte suppression, byte counts would be a consequence of it, not a sibling account.

evidence_for_A.finding: The defining C3 authorities own NO I/O. G01's authorized_sav_numeric_physical_material is a pure representation lookup (31a9afd7d91ed4cb2fb1c1aab3ef86a5fdda1f85), and both accepted qualified tests contain ZERO pyreadstat/read_sav/read_dta/usecols references (fb7b090809a609a3b0157f1ed8fcdcd8e8784525, 3901f10a487856f5f232ae6700fff407ac99725e).
evidence_for_A.why_it_matters: An authority that never invokes a reader cannot require or measure physical read suppression for its own witness.

evidence_for_A.finding: The authority chain's reference decoder realises variable scope at the CELL-EMISSION layer over a whole-file read, and has zero usecols (d3d828c171ea9fdd0e90563aff6ef705f5aae2cf).
evidence_for_A.why_it_matters: Under B the defining implementation would violate its own ceiling at freeze time. That is not a coherent reconstruction of intent.

evidence_for_A.finding: ZERO occurrences of suppress / column-level / byte-level / projection / unselected / partial read / skip columns across all seven commissioned authority artifacts.
evidence_for_A.why_it_matters: A law that requires suppression would state it. B's requirement appears nowhere.

evidence_for_A.finding: READ_ONLY qualified the ACTIVITY ('only a read is performed': bounded, non-retaining, non-semantic) and was dropped exactly when numeric read counters replaced it.
evidence_for_A.why_it_matters: It never meant 'only these bytes'. The lineage shows a qualitative activity bound becoming a counted budget.

evidence_for_A.finding: C4B frames the scope question as 'metadata/decoder-admission only; or selected-column decoder validation' (commission line 105) and C4B's C1 authority freeze ceiling is PHYSICAL_REPRESENTATION_ONLY.
evidence_for_A.why_it_matters: 'Selected-column' is used as a validation scope, and PHYSICAL as a representation ceiling, not an I/O ceiling.

evidence_for_A.finding: Four independent lanes treat byte counts as an account distinct from selected reads: C4 accounting law, HQ190-C ACC-07 vs ACC-09, the C4B warrant template, and HQ196's successor.
evidence_for_A.why_it_matters: Consistent structural treatment across independent authorities.

evidence_for_B.note: Recorded for completeness. B is not merely unproven; it is unstated.

evidence_for_B.finding: The hostile review noted that downstream selected-variable exactness assertions do not constrain which columns are physically READ (2e43b8c1e975974add3ac2cecfbd6daa96afd98b).
evidence_for_B.why_adverse: If the frozen figure were a physical-read account, no existing consumer layer could satisfy it — which would make the frozen ceiling unsatisfiable by its own chain.

neutral_technical_facts.note: Treated as facts about the runtime, not as the definition of the governing term.
neutral_technical_facts.measured: identical read calls and bytes with and without usecols, reproduced independently by 2e43b8c1e975974add3ac2cecfbd6daa96afd98b and d5ce4ecff6acc25d199577a7859de7e98514e9fd

why_not_C.considered: Possibility C — that the record establishes some other exact meaning.
why_not_C.finding: No third meaning is supported. The only candidate meanings in evidence are A and B. The record's vocabulary is exhaustibly a tier/scope vocabulary; it contains no I/O-suppression vocabulary at all.

why_not_ambiguous.the_test_applied: Can the record distinguish A from B? Yes, on four independent documentary grounds (A1, A2, A3, A5), none of which depends on the current implementation.
why_not_ambiguous.residual_acknowledged: No verbatim definitional sentence exists, so A is a well-supported reconstruction rather than a quotation. That is recorded as a residual in 07_LIMITS_AND_RESIDUAL_AMBIGUITY.json and is a ratification question for HQ, not an ambiguity that blocks the determination.
why_not_ambiguous.verdict: PHYSICAL_SELECTED_MEANING_AMBIGUOUS is NOT returned. The evidence is one-directional and multi-sourced, and B would require a requirement that appears nowhere while being violated by the chain's own defining implementation.
